Name: Share Experience - VPP Patch
Author: DaveYognaut01
Description:
For the full detailed description of this mod please see the original mod here:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22163]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22163[/url]


This is a patch of that mod that adds VPP (VanillaPlusProfessions) support / compatibility.
Compatibility has also been added in consideration with the MasteryEXP - In order to prevent the shared EXP counting excessively towards it.
It uses the Vanilla / originally intended rates. Farming is 50% and everything else is 100%.


If the original author wants to integrate my code into the original mod; the source code is public and I can remove this patch once confirmed integrated.


I personally used this patch the entire playthrough I had to 100% completion without any issues - but if you have any issues let me know.

[b][size=4]Installation Instructions:[/size][/b]
Replace the original Share Experience mod with this one. They are effectively the same mods but this one has the VPP patch.
That's it!

Downloads.Description:
Initial Release; this patch takes the 0.0.6 of the original mod and adds VPP compatibility.
Let me know if there's any issues!
